fcm_receiver_unavailable.title: Doorbell notifications are unavailable for {entry_title}
fcm_receiver_unavailable.description:
Doorbell calls are not reaching Home Assistant — account {entry_title}. Cameras, locks, balance and history work as usual.

The integration is already trying to reconnect. If this warning stays:

1. Reload the account — that usually does it.
2. Still there? Reconnect it.
3. Still there? Update the integration and report the problem.
